_comment: RAG retrieval weights per DocumentCategory, loaded by ai/rag/retriever.py at import time. A weight of 0.0 for a source means that source is skipped entirely (no wasted API call), not zeroed after the fetch. Written by 'scripts/measure_rag_recall.py --sweep --apply' for every category whose best grid ratio beats the current one by at least one hit (a thin margin is applied too and flagged in that category's _evidence). Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the loader. Edit by hand only to override what the sweep found.

news._evidence: scripts/measure_rag_recall.py --sweep, real run: 60/61 hits at this ratio. THIN MARGIN CAVEAT: only 2 hit(s) or fewer better than the previous config in this specific run -- applied anyway per Jenny's call (2026-08-08: a stable plateau across multiple grid points is a real signal even at small sample size, worth more than a hard block), but worth re-confirming on the next few sweeps before treating this as fully settled.
